class.name: MaszynaTrainsetClassifier
class.brief_description: The original's kind of a train, which MaSzyna's timetables are written for.
class.description: The rule [RailVehicleServer] works a trainset's type out by in MaSzyna ([code]TController::AutoRewident()[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:2146-2175[/code]): of the wagons (a vehicle of power below 1) - those with the R brake delay, those with G and without R, and the rest - a passenger train while the goods wagons are fewer than both 4 and the others, else a goods train; none without a wagon. It is the C++ override of [method RailVehicleTrainsetClassifier.classify], called through that method - the class declares no method of its own. The plugin hands it to the server as it starts ([method RailVehicleServer.trainset_set_classifier]).
